blind.description: A straight flight of five stone steps constructed from dressed rectangular masonry blocks. Each tread consists of three blocks: a dark grey slate-like center stone flanked by tan/buff stone blocks. Distinct greenish moss or mortar lines fill the joints between the blocks. The sides and rear form solid vertical block walls.
blind.from_above: A rectangular grid showing the stone treads arranged in three columns, with a dark grey central runner flanked by tan stone blocks across multiple horizontal step levels.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 ft tall), and about 2.5 ft wide.
